title: Recent Charges Left Out of a Parking License Cure Amount
content:
Collections note, Parking License. For a license held two years or more, charges posted in the last month are left out of the cure amount, and how much is left out depends on whether the household's Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in autopay.

## Note

When the license has been held at least 730 days and the lease is enrolled in autopay, the charges posted on the license within 1 month before the handling date are left out of the cure amount; when the license has been held at least 730 days and the lease is not enrolled in autopay, only the monthly fee lines posted within 1 month before the handling date are left out; in every other case nothing is left out. What is left out is subtracted from the whole parking balance.

- **Charges** are every charge line of the license: monthly license fees, activation, remote, hang tag, space move, early cancellation and reinstatement fees, EV charging energy and idle fee lines, and violation fines. Credits and payments are not charges.
- **Days held** run from the license's start date to the handling date.
- **Autopay** is the enrollment shown on the Apartment Home Lease.

## What is left out

| Days held | Apartment Home Lease enrolled in autopay | Left out of the cure amount |
|---|---|---|
| 730 or more | yes | every charge posted within 1 month before the handling date |
| 730 or more | no | only the monthly fee lines posted within 1 month before the handling date |
| fewer than 730 | any | nothing |

## Worked example (hypothetical license held 900 days, whole parking balance $310.00)

Posted within the month before the handling date: a monthly fee of $95.00, an idle fee line of $24.00 and a fine of $50.00, $169.00 of charges in all.

- Lease enrolled in autopay: $310.00 less $169.00 leaves $141.00.
- Lease not enrolled in autopay: $310.00 less the $95.00 monthly fee leaves $215.00.
- Had the license been held 729 days: nothing is left out; $310.00.
